name_note: GTDB places this species in the split genus Ruminococcus_C; the genomes carry the NCBI name Ruminococcus callidus.

sentences.text: Ruminococcus callidus occurs among human faecal bacteria; a species-specific 16S rRNA probe, Rcal 733, was designed to detect members of the species.
That probe was designed from 16S rRNA sequences isolated from faeces of five healthy adults and added to a panel used to describe faecal microbiota of healthy adults.
In a study of African-origin women, lean Ghanaians had a significantly greater proportion of Ruminococcus callidus.
A study of gut microbiota reported reduced content of Ruminococcus callidus in patients with Parkinson's disease relative to healthy volunteers.
